card.name: Advice to use back-up contraception
card.fires_on: Words right after 'advise/instruct/counsel patients to' in contraception advice, such as 'use', 'a', 'non' (before -hormonal) and 'add'. It fires where a back-up birth control method is about to be named.

modes.label: Use / a before back-up method
modes.description: The verb 'use' or the article 'a' after an instruction to patients about back-up contraception.
modes.example: instruct patients to<< use>> a non-hormonal back-up method

modes.label: non before hormonal
modes.description: The word 'non' starting 'non-hormonal' in additional contraception advice.
modes.example: Women should use additional or alternative<< non>>-hormonal birth control.

modes.label: Number of methods
modes.description: A number before 'effective forms of contraception'.
modes.example: Females of reproductive potential must use <<2>> effective forms of contraception
